title_en: Chinese Humor (11/20): A Driverless Car's Little Hiccup
note_en: 把A当成B means "to take A for B, mistake A for B": 传感器突然把塑料袋当成了一个行人 "the sensors suddenly mistook the plastic bag for a pedestrian." 把 moves the object (the bag) in front of the verb, and 当成 must be followed by what it was taken for. English uses a separate verb ("mistake... for"), while Chinese builds the whole idea from 把 plus 当成; the text uses the pattern again for the tree shadow: 把风中摇晃的树影当成了人.
